item.title: HKUST Partners for Hong Kong’s First Hydrogen Innovation Hub
item.description: Hong Kong establishes a hydrogen innovation hub to advance production, storage and fuel-cell technologies, accelerating commercial deployment and supporting wider low-carbon energy goals.

item.title: Vietnam: National Digital Platform for Civil Judgment Enforcement
item.description: Vietnam has launched a nationwide digital platform and intelligent operations centre to streamline civil judgment enforcement, enhancing efficiency, transparency and citizen access.

item.title: Singapore: Tech-Enabled Approach to Future-Ready Healthcare
item.description: Singapore is leveraging technology, digital tools and innovative care models to transform eldercare and hospital development, significantly improving efficiency, quality, safety and overall patient outcomes.

item.title: India: IIT Madras Leads Discussions on Safe, Trustworthy AI
item.description: IIT Madras’ Centre for Responsible AI hosted a two-day Conclave to advance safe, trustworthy, inclusive and ethically governed AI practices, fostering collaboration, innovation and research across the Global South.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor Harnesses Waste-to-Energy for Sustainable Cities
item.description: Selangor is adopting waste-to-energy technology to reduce landfill dependence, generate electricity and support sustainable urban growth through advanced, data-driven waste management.

item.title: The Philippines: DICT Partners to Create Millions of Digital Jobs
item.description: The DICT has partnered with leading startup enablers to strengthen the Philippine startup ecosystem, foster innovation and create millions of sustainable, high-quality digital and digitally-enabled jobs by 2028.

item.title: Australia: Victoria Embraces Real-Time Smart Traffic Control
item.description: Victoria’s new high-tech road network control centre will monitor the West Gate Tunnel and surrounding corridors in real time, significantly enhancing overall traffic safety, flow and efficiency from day one.

item.title: Indonesia: Digital Innovation to Strengthen National Health Insurance
item.description: Indonesia is advancing digital health innovation and anti-fraud measures to strengthen its National Health Insurance program, improve public health and ensure universal, high-quality coverage.

item.title: Hong Kong: Trilateral Effort Targets Mars Atmospheric Study
item.description: A new joint laboratory launches advanced spectroscopic technologies to support Tianwen-3, enhancing Mars atmospheric analysis and deep space exploration capabilities.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Traceability Strengthens Global Confidence
item.description: Vietnam is strengthening product traceability through advanced digital technologies, building trust, enhancing quality and boosting the global competitiveness of its goods in both e-commerce and export markets.
